app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.YWRkQWN0aXZpdHk..source: Adds a new activity. Includes `more_activities_scheduled_in_context` property in response's `additional_data` which indicates whether there are more undone activities scheduled with the same deal, person or organization (depending on the supplied data). For more information, see the tutorial for <a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-adding-an-activity" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">adding an activity<-a>. <br -> <br -> ***Starting from 30.09.2024, activity attendees will receive updates only if the activity owner has an active calendar sync***
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.YWRkQWN0aXZpdHk..message: 新增一項活動。在回應的 `additional_data` 中包含 `more_activities_scheduled_in_context` 屬性，用以指示是否排定了更多與同一筆交易、人員或組織相關聯的未完成活動（取決於提供的資料）。如需詳細資訊，請參閱<a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-adding-an-activity" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">新增活動<-a>的教學課程。<br -> <br -> ***自 2024 年 9 月 30 日起，僅當活動擁有者具有作用中的日曆同步時，活動參與者才會收到更新***

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.YWRkRGVhbA.desc.source: Adds a new deal. All deals created through the Pipedrive API will have a `origin` set to `API`. Note that you can supply additional custom fields along with the request that are not described here. These custom fields are different for each Pipedrive account and can be recognized by long hashes as keys. To determine which custom fields exists, fetch the dealFields and look for `key` values. For more information, see the tutorial for <a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-creating-a-deal" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">adding a deal<-a>.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.YWRkRGVhbA.desc.message: 新增一筆交易。所有透過 Pipedrive API 建立的交易將把 `origin` 設為 `API`。請注意，您可以隨請求提供此處未說明的額外自訂欄位。這些自訂欄位在每個 Pipedrive 帳戶中各不相同，可透過長雜湊值作為索引鍵來識別。若要確定存在哪些自訂欄位，請擷取 dealFields 並尋找 `key` 值。如需詳細資訊，請參閱<a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-creating-a-deal" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">新增交易<-a>的教學課程。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.YWRkT3JnYW5pemF0.source: Adds a new organization. Note that you can supply additional custom fields along with the request that are not described here. These custom fields are different for each Pipedrive account and can be recognized by long hashes as keys. To determine which custom fields exists, fetch the organizationFields and look for `key` values. For more information, see the tutorial for <a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-adding-an-organization" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">adding an organization<-a>.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.YWRkT3JnYW5pemF0.message: 新增一個組織。請注意，您可以隨請求提供此處未說明的額外自訂欄位。這些自訂欄位在每個 Pipedrive 帳戶中各不相同，可透過長雜湊值作為索引鍵來識別。若要確定存在哪些自訂欄位，請擷取 organizationFields 並尋找 `key` 值。如需詳細資訊，請參閱<a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-adding-an-organization" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">新增組織<-a>的教學課程。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.YWRkTGVhZA.desc.source: Creates a lead. A lead always has to be linked to a person or an organization or both. All leads created through the Pipedrive API will have a lead source and origin set to `API`. Here's the tutorial for <a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-adding-a-lead" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">adding a lead<-a>. If a lead contains custom fields, the fields' values will be included in the response in the same format as with the `Deals` endpoints. If a custom field's value hasn't been set for the lead, it won't appear in the response. Please note that leads do not have a separate set of custom fields, instead they inherit the custom fields' structure from deals. See an example given in the <a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-updating-custom-field-value" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">updating custom fields' values tutorial<-a>.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.YWRkTGVhZA.desc.message: 建立潛在客戶。潛在客戶必須始終連結至人員或組織，或兩者皆連結。所有透過 Pipedrive API 建立的潛在客戶將把潛在客戶來源與來源地設為 `API`。此處為<a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-adding-a-lead" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">新增潛在客戶<-a>的教學課程。如果潛在客戶包含自訂欄位，欄位的值將以與 `Deals` 端點相同的格式包含在回應中。如果尚未為潛在客戶設定自訂欄位的值，則不會出現在回應中。請注意，潛在客戶沒有獨立的一組自訂欄位，而是繼承交易的自訂欄位結構。請參閱<a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-updating-custom-field-value" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">更新自訂欄位值教學課程<-a>中給出的範例。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.YWRkUGVyc29u.des.source:
Adds a new person. Note that you can supply additional custom fields along with the request that are not described here. These custom fields are different for each Pipedrive account and can be recognized by long hashes as keys. To determine which custom fields exists, fetch the personFields and look for `key` values.
If a company uses the [Campaigns product](https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-campaigns-in-pipedrive-api), then this endpoint will also accept and return the `data.marketing_status` field.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.YWRkUGVyc29u.des.message:
新增一個聯絡人。請注意，您可以隨請求提供此處未說明的額外自訂欄位。這些自訂欄位在每個 Pipedrive 帳戶中各不相同，可透過長雜湊值作為索引鍵來識別。若要確定存在哪些自訂欄位，請擷取 personFields 並尋找 `key` 值。
如果公司使用 [Campaigns 產品](https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-campaigns-in-pipedrive-api)，則此端點也會接受並傳回 `data.marketing_status` 欄位。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.YWRkUHJvamVjdA.d.source: Adds a new project. Note that you can supply additional custom fields along with the request that are not described here. These custom fields are different for each Pipedrive account and can be recognized by long hashes as keys.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.YWRkUHJvamVjdA.d.message: 新增一個專案。請注意，您可以隨請求提供此處未說明的額外自訂欄位。這些自訂欄位在每個 Pipedrive 帳戶中各不相同，可透過長雜湊值作為索引鍵來識別。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0QWN0aXZpdGll.message: 傳回指派給特定使用者的所有活動。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0RGVhbA.desc.source: Returns the details of a specific deal. Note that this also returns some additional fields which are not present when asking for all deals – such as deal age and stay in pipeline stages. Also note that custom fields appear as long hashes in the resulting data. These hashes can be mapped against the `key` value of dealFields. For more information, see the tutorial for <a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-getting-details-of-a-deal" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">getting details of a deal<-a>.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0RGVhbA.desc.message: 傳回特定交易的詳細資訊。請注意，這也會傳回一些在查詢所有交易時不會出現的額外欄位，例如交易年齡以及留在管道階段的時間。另請注意，自訂欄位在傳回資料中會顯示為長雜湊值。這些雜湊值可以對應至 dealFields 的 `key` 值。如需詳細資訊，請參閱<a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-getting-details-of-a-deal" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">取得交易詳細資訊<-a>的教學課程。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0RGVhbHM.desc.source: Returns all deals. For more information, see the tutorial for <a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-getting-all-deals" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">getting all deals<-a>.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0RGVhbHM.desc.message: 傳回所有交易。如需詳細資訊，請參閱<a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-getting-all-deals" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">取得所有交易<-a>的教學課程。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0T3JnYW5pemF0.source: Returns the details of an organization. Note that this also returns some additional fields which are not present when asking for all organizations. Also note that custom fields appear as long hashes in the resulting data. These hashes can be mapped against the `key` value of organizationFields.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0T3JnYW5pemF0.message: 傳回組織的詳細資訊。請注意，這也會傳回一些在查詢所有組織時不會出現的額外欄位。另請注意，自訂欄位在傳回資料中會顯示為長雜湊值。這些雜湊值可以對應至 organizationFields 的 `key` 值。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0TGVhZA.desc.source: Returns details of a specific lead. If a lead contains custom fields, the fields' values will be included in the response in the same format as with the `Deals` endpoints. If a custom field's value hasn't been set for the lead, it won't appear in the response. Please note that leads do not have a separate set of custom fields, instead they inherit the custom fields’ structure from deals.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0TGVhZA.desc.message: 傳回特定潛在客戶的詳細資訊。如果潛在客戶包含自訂欄位，欄位的值將以與 `Deals` 端點相同的格式包含在回應中。如果尚未為潛在客戶設定自訂欄位的值，則不會出現在回應中。請注意，潛在客戶沒有獨立的一組自訂欄位，而是繼承交易的自訂欄位結構。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0TGVhZHM.desc.source: Returns multiple leads. Leads are sorted by the time they were created, from oldest to newest. Pagination can be controlled using `limit` and `start` query parameters. If a lead contains custom fields, the fields' values will be included in the response in the same format as with the `Deals` endpoints. If a custom field's value hasn't been set for the lead, it won't appear in the response. Please note that leads do not have a separate set of custom fields, instead they inherit the custom fields' structure from deals.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0TGVhZHM.desc.message: 傳回多個潛在客戶。潛在客戶按建立時間從舊到新排序。可以使用 `limit` 和 `start` 查詢參數來控制分頁。如果潛在客戶包含自訂欄位，欄位的值將以與 `Deals` 端點相同的格式包含在回應中。如果尚未為潛在客戶設定自訂欄位的值，則不會出現在回應中。請注意，潛在客戶沒有獨立的一組自訂欄位，而是繼承交易的自訂欄位結構。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0Tm90ZQ.desc.source: Returns details about a specific note.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0Tm90ZQ.desc.message: 傳回特定備註的詳細資訊。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0UGVyc29u.des.source:
Returns the details of a person. Note that this also returns some additional fields which are not present when asking for all persons. Also note that custom fields appear as long hashes in the resulting data. These hashes can be mapped against the `key` value of personFields.
If a company uses the [Campaigns product](https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-campaigns-in-pipedrive-api), then this endpoint will also return the `data.marketing_status` field.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0UGVyc29u.des.message:
傳回聯絡人的詳細資訊。請注意，這也會傳回一些在查詢所有聯絡人時不會出現的額外欄位。另請注意，自訂欄位在傳回資料中會顯示為長雜湊值。這些雜湊值可以對應至 personFields 的 `key` 值。
如果公司使用 [Campaigns 產品](https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-campaigns-in-pipedrive-api)，則此端點也會傳回 `data.marketing_status` 欄位。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0UHJvamVjdA.d.source: Returns the details of a specific project. Also note that custom fields appear as long hashes in the resulting data. These hashes can be mapped against the `key` value of project fields.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0UHJvamVjdA.d.message: 傳回特定專案的詳細資訊。另請注意，自訂欄位在傳回資料中會顯示為長雜湊值。這些雜湊值可以對應至專案欄位的 `key` 值。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0UHJvamVjdHM..source: Returns all projects. This is a cursor-paginated endpoint. For more information, please refer to our documentation on <a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-core-api-concepts-pagination" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">pagination<-a>.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0UHJvamVjdHM..message: 傳回所有專案。這是使用游標分頁的端點。如需詳細資訊，請參閱我們關於<a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-core-api-concepts-pagination" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">分頁<-a>的文件。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0VGFza3M.desc.message: 傳回所有任務。這是使用游標分頁的端點。如需詳細資訊，請參閱我們關於<a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-core-api-concepts-pagination" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">分頁<-a>的文件。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.Z2V0VGFzaw.desc.message: 傳回特定任務的詳細資訊。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.ZGVsZXRl.short_d.source: Delete records from the given table in app "Pipedrive"

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.ZGVsZXRlQWN0aXZp.source: Marks an activity as deleted. After 30 days, the activity will be permanently deleted.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.ZGVsZXRlQWN0aXZp.message: 將活動標記為已刪除。30 天後，該活動將會被永久刪除。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.ZGVsZXRlRGVhbA.d.source: Marks a deal as deleted. After 30 days, the deal will be permanently deleted.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.ZGVsZXRlRGVhbA.d.message: 將交易標記為已刪除。30 天後，該交易將會被永久刪除。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.ZGVsZXRlT3JnYW5p.source: Marks an organization as deleted. After 30 days, the organization will be permanently deleted.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.ZGVsZXRlT3JnYW5p.message: 將組織標記為已刪除。30 天後，該組織將會被永久刪除。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.ZGVsZXRlUGVyc29u.source: Marks a person as deleted. After 30 days, the person will be permanently deleted.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.ZGVsZXRlUGVyc29u.message: 將聯絡人標記為已刪除。30 天後，該聯絡人將會被永久刪除。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.ZGVsZXRlVGFzaw.d.source: Marks a task as deleted. If the task has subtasks then those will also be deleted.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.ZGVsZXRlVGFzaw.d.message: 將任務標記為已刪除。若該任務有子任務，子任務也會一併刪除。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **Pipedrive** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message:
使用已設定連線的驗證向 **Pipedrive** 進行自訂 HTTP / REST API 呼叫。

指定 HTTP 方法、URI 路徑（相對於連線的 API 基礎 URL）、選用的查詢參數、標頭和請求主體。回應將以包含狀態碼、回應標頭和回應主體的雜湊形式傳回。

當端點尚未在此應用程式中以第一類動作形式提供時，請使用此動作。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: The request body. The effective type depends on `body_type`: JSON/form/YAML expect a hash, XML/text expect a string, multipart expects a file structure, binary expects raw bytes.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 請求主體。有效類型取決於 `body_type`：JSON/form/YAML 期望雜湊，XML/text 期望字串，multipart 期望檔案結構，binary 期望原始位元組。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Upload a file using `multipart/form-data`. The body must be a @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" structure (filename + content + mime_type). The framework builds the multipart envelope and sets the boundary header.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 使用 `multipart/form-data` 上傳檔案。主體必須是 @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" 結構（filename + content + mime_type）。架構會建立 multipart 封套並設定 boundary 標頭。
使用 multipart/form-data 上傳檔案

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Pass the body to the REST client unchanged; the client decides serialization based on its configured `data` option and the value type
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 原封不動地將主體傳遞給 REST 用戶端；用戶端會根據其設定的 `data` 選項和值類型來決定序列化方式

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Pass-through; use connection serialization and let the REST client decide
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 透傳；使用連線序列化並由 REST 用戶端決定

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Send the body as raw bytes. The body must be a binary value. Sets `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` unless overridden by `hdr`.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 將主體作為原始位元組傳送。主體必須是二進位值。除非被 `hdr` 覆蓋，否則會設定 `Content-Type: application/octet-stream`。
將主體作為原始位元組傳送

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Serialize a hash of form fields as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. The body must be a hash whose values are scalars (strings/numbers/booleans).
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 將表單欄位的雜湊序列化為 `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`。主體必須是值為純量（字串/數字/布林值）的雜湊。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Serialize body as application/x-www-form-urlencoded form fields
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 將主體序列化為 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 表單欄位

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Serialize the body as JSON; sets `Content-Type: application/json`. The body should be a hash, list, or scalar value.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 將主體序列化為 JSON；設定 `Content-Type: application/json`。主體應為雜湊、清單或純量值。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Send the body as plain text. The body must be a string. Sets `Content-Type: text/plain`.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 將主體作為純文字傳送。主體必須是字串。設定 `Content-Type: text/plain`。
將主體作為 text/plain 傳送

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Send the body as XML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to XML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/xml`.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 將主體作為 XML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 XML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/xml`。
將主體作為 XML 傳送

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Send the body as YAML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to YAML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 將主體作為 YAML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 YAML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`。
將主體作為 YAML 傳送

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Selects the body serialization mode and the corresponding `Content-Type` header. Changing this field reshapes the `body` editor - selecting JSON exposes a JSON editor, selecting Multipart Form exposes a file picker, and so on.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 選擇主體序列化模式及對應的 `Content-Type` 標頭。變更此欄位會重新配置 `body` 編輯器 — 選擇 JSON 會顯示 JSON 編輯器，選擇 Multipart 表單會顯示檔案選擇器，依此類推。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: How the body is serialized and what Content-Type is sent
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 主體如何序列化以及傳送何種 Content-Type

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: If `True`, non-2xx HTTP responses return as the normal response hash (with the actual status code) instead of raising `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`. Useful for handling 4xx/5xx as data - e.g. checking whether a resource exists. Overrides the connection's `error_passthru` setting for this call only.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 若為 `True`，非 2xx HTTP 回應會作為正常的相應雜湊傳回（帶有實際狀態碼），而非引發 `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`。有助於將 4xx/5xx 作為資料處理 — 例如檢查資源是否存在。僅針對本次呼叫覆蓋連線的 `error_passthru` 設定。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Return non-2xx responses normally instead of throwing
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 正常傳回非 2xx 回應而非拋出例外

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Optional list of HTTP status codes treated as success. If set and the response status is not in this list, the action throws `REST-STATUS-ERROR`. When unset, the REST client's default behavior applies (typically: 2xx is success, non-2xx throws).
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 視為成功的 HTTP 狀態碼選擇性清單。若有設定且回應狀態不在此清單中，該動作會拋出 `REST-STATUS-ERROR`。若未設定，則套用 REST 用戶端的預設行為（通常：2xx 為成功，非 2xx 則拋出例外）。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Response status codes treated as success
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 視為成功的回應狀態碼

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Hash of custom headers added to the request. These override any default headers set by `body_type` (e.g. supplying `Content-Type` here wins over the body-type default).
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 新增至請求的自訂標頭雜湊。這些標頭會覆蓋由 `body_type` 設定的任何預設標頭（例如，在此處提供 `Content-Type` 會優先於主體類型的預設值）。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: If `True`, the response hash includes a `debug` sub-hash containing the request method/URL/headers (with sensitive values redacted), request and response sizes, and round-trip duration. Useful when investigating slow or failing calls. Off by default to keep responses lean.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 若為 `True`，回應雜湊包含 `debug` 子雜湊，其中含有請求方法/URL/標頭（敏感值已被隱藏）、請求與回應大小以及來回時間。在調查過慢或失敗的呼叫時很有用。預設為關閉以保持回應精簡。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Include request/timing/size debug info in the response
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 在回應中包含請求/計時/大小等除錯資訊

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: The HTTP method to use for the request
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 用於請求的 HTTP 方法

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: The HTTP method to use for the request
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 用於請求的 HTTP 方法

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: The URI path relative to the connection's API base URL. May contain `{name}` placeholders that are replaced from `path_vars`. Example: `/users/{id}/comments`.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 相於連線 API 基底 URL 的 URI 路徑。可能包含從 `path_vars` 替換的 `{name}` 預留位置。範例：`/users/{id}/comments`。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: The URI path relative to the connection's API base URL. May contain '{name}' placeholders that are replaced from 'path_vars'. Example: '/users/{id}/comments'
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 相對於連線 API 根 URL 的 URI 路徑。可能包含從 'path_vars' 替換的 '{name}' 預留位置。範例：'/users/{id}/comments'

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Hash of values substituted into `{name}` placeholders in the URI path. Example: with `path = /users/{id}` and `path_vars = {id: 123}` the framework sends `/users/123`. Values are URL-encoded.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 代入 URI 路徑中 `{name}` 預留位置的值 Hash。範例：使用 `path = /users/{id}` 與 `path_vars = {id: 123}`，框架會傳送 `/users/123`。值均經過 URL 編碼。
路徑中 {name} 預留位置的值

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source: Hash of query string parameters to append to the URI path. Values are URL-encoded; list values are joined with `,`.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.message: 要附加至 URI 路徑的查詢字串參數 Hash。值均經過 URL 編碼；清單值會以 `,` 連接。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.dXBkYXRlQWN0aXZp.source: Updates an activity. Includes `more_activities_scheduled_in_context` property in response's `additional_data` which indicates whether there are more undone activities scheduled with the same deal, person or organization (depending on the supplied data). <br -> <br -> ***Starting from 30.09.2024, activity attendees will receive updates only if the activity owner has an active calendar sync***
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.dXBkYXRlQWN0aXZp.message: 更新活動。在回應的 `additional_data` 中包含 `more_activities_scheduled_in_context` 屬性，表示是否排程了與相同交易、聯絡人或組織相關聯的更多未完成活動（取決於提供的資料）。<br -> <br -> ***自 2024 年 9 月 30 日起，僅當活動擁有者啟用了日曆同步時，活動參與者才會收到更新***

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.dXBkYXRlT3JnYW5p.source: Updates the properties of an organization.

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.dXBkYXRlTGVhZA.d.source: Updates one or more properties of a lead. Only properties included in the request will be updated. Send `null` to unset a property (applicable for example for `value`, `person_id` or `organization_id`). If a lead contains custom fields, the fields' values will be included in the response in the same format as with the `Deals` endpoints. If a custom field's value hasn't been set for the lead, it won't appear in the response. Please note that leads do not have a separate set of custom fields, instead they inherit the custom fields’ structure from deals. See an example given in the <a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-updating-custom-field-value" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">updating custom fields’ values tutorial<-a>.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.dXBkYXRlTGVhZA.d.message: 更新潛在客戶的一或多個屬性。僅更新請求中包含的屬性。傳送 `null` 可取消設定屬性（例如適用於 `value`、`person_id` 或 `organization_id`）。如果潛在客戶包含自訂欄位，欄位值將以與 `Deals` 端點相同的格式包含在回應中。如果潛在客戶尚未設定自訂欄位的值，該欄位將不會出現在回應中。請注意，潛在客戶沒有單獨的一組自訂欄位，而是繼承自交易的自訂欄位結構。請參閱<a href="https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-updating-custom-field-value" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">更新自訂欄位值教學課程<-a>中的範例。

app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.dXBkYXRlUGVyc29u.source:
Updates the properties of a person. For more information, see the tutorial for updating a person<-a>.
If a company uses the [Campaigns product](https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-campaigns-in-pipedrive-api), then this endpoint will also accept and return the `data.marketing_status` field.
app.UGlwZWRyaXZl.action.dXBkYXRlUGVyc29u.message:
更新聯絡人的屬性。如需詳細資訊，請參閱更新聯絡人<-a>教學課程。
如果公司使用 [Campaigns 產品](https:-pipedrive.readme.io-docs-campaigns-in-pipedrive-api)，則此端點也會接受並傳回 `data.marketing_status` 欄位。
